# Zubara

> Direct-booking websites, M-Pesa checkout, and property operations software for BnBs, cottages, villas, and serviced apartments in Kenya.

## What Zubara Does
- Gives each hospitality property its own branded direct-booking website on a dedicated subdomain (`<property>.zubara.co.ke`) or custom domain.
- Processes instant guest payments via M-Pesa STK Push and Paybill/Till verification, settling directly to the host's receiving account with zero per-booking commission.
- Prevents double bookings through date-level reservation locks and two-way iCal calendar sync with Airbnb and Booking.com.
- Issues verified booking receipts and provides a host management portal at https://app.zubara.co.ke.
